scripts.db:local: npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:remoto: npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.publicar: npx --yes wrangler@4 pages deploy public --project-name gestao-combustivel --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.lint: npx --yes eslint@8 --no-eslintrc -c .eslintrc.json --ext .js,.mjs public functions lib scripts tests && py -m compileall -q scripts tests/py
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:py
